name: SMS Sender ID Registry (SGNIC, IMDA subsidiary)

scam_info.sample: List of Organisations with At Least One Whitelisted Sender ID Last Updated: 25 Nov 2026 23:59 ... ZINGKEY PTE. LTD. TRAVELUSTAZ PTE. LTD.
scam_info.notes: Allowlist of organisation names only (no sender IDs). Paginated 50 per page (~68 pages, ~3,400 orgs per survey); updated daily. Linked from sgnic.sg. The robots.txt URL serves an "Under Construction" page. Only page 1 was fetched.

scam_info.sample: from 31 January 2023 onwards, all organisations intending to use alpha/numeric/alphanumeric Sender IDs in their SMS messages to Singapore mobile users must first register the Sender IDs via the SSIR portal. All non-registered Sender IDs will be marked as “Likely-SCAM”.
scam_info.notes: Defines the "Likely-SCAM" sender label used by SG telcos. Contact smsregistry@sgnic.sg.

sms_sender_ids: Likely-SCAM (label applied by telcos to unregistered sender IDs)

notes: Sender-ID allowlisting infrastructure. The public "Sender ID Query" offers no bulk lookup (per survey). Use the org list only as weak evidence of a legitimate SMS sender.
